payload.title: AI action confirmation (confirmAiAction to request.ai.executeAction) authorizes the confirming user by channel membership alone and executes the stored tool under the original requester's stored roles, so a member without authority, or a requester whose role was revoked, can release an actuation for up to 24 hours
evidence: apps/messaging-service/src/ai/services/ai-chat-bridge.service.ts:356 (the confirmer is authorized by active membership of the action's channel only)
apps/messaging-service/src/ai/services/ai-chat-bridge.service.ts:390 (request.ai.executeAction forwards confirmedBy as a bare user-id string)
apps/ai-service/src/actions/ai-action.responder.ts:24 (ExecuteActionNatsRequest is a local all-optional interface; :48 checks presence only)
apps/ai-service/src/actions/action-proposal.service.ts:180 (the tool runs as proposal.requestedBy with the stored requesterRoles; the confirmer's current authority is never read)
payload.rule_violated: D2 and the repo rule of root-cause enforcement: an actuation must be decided against a validated caller's current authority at execution time, never against a caller-supplied id string or a role snapshot.
payload.notes: Program module-boundaries, package PKG-09, release R5.
